purpose: Rank pre-declared university/higher-education and regional-city municipalities by demographic and migration-profile similarity to Luleå before using any analogue signal in migration smoothing.

features.description: Difference in total population size on log scale.
Distance between normalized single-year age profiles 15-39.
Difference in year-to-year volatility of migration rates ages 18-29.

index.standardization: robust z-score across candidate pool plus Lulea
index.distance: weighted root mean square feature distance

governance: Candidate municipalities are fixed before similarity scores are generated.
Similarity ranking is descriptive and must not be tuned from Lulea forecast errors.
Analogue signal remains diagnostic until rolling-origin smoothing tests compare local+analogue+national against local+national.
No single analogue municipality may replace Lulea observations by default.

smoothingCandidate.selectionRule: five highest similarityScore municipalities from the pre-locked analogue index
smoothingCandidate.role: third reference signal between Lulea local profile and national profile; diagnostic only

requiredBeforePromotion: n+1 net migration MAE not worse
at least one n+1 metric strictly better
n+2 net migration MAE not worse

smoothingCandidate.governance: Do not change topK, selected municipalities, analogue weights, or thresholds after viewing smoothing outcomes.

backtestSelection.method: rerank candidate pool at each rolling origin using only years available through that origin
backtestSelection.note: The current 2015-2024 top five is descriptive for the 2025 model only and is not retroactively imposed on historical origins.

structuralTarget.analogueAggregation: similarity-score-weighted age/sex shares among the origin-specific top five
structuralTarget.formula: adjacent Lulea local-age mean + 0.5*Sweden age curvature + 0.5*analogue-pool age curvature
structuralTarget.retentionRule: same information+persistence local-retention rule as the existing adaptive smoothing candidate
structuralTarget.totalPreservation: smooth gross in and gross out age/sex shares separately, renormalize each to 1, then multiply by the original Lulea gross in/out annual totals; net profile = smoothed gross in - smoothed gross out
structuralTarget.governance: Weights and formula are fixed before rolling-origin forecast outcomes are generated.
